title: Product Management — Every Tab of the Product Profile
purpose: After you create a product, its profile holds everything about it. This guide explains each tab in the profile's left menu and the import option on the product list.
meta: Document · Shipping Detail · Compliance Data · Quality Requirement · AI Risk Screening · CPSC eFiling · Packaging Detail · QR Code
Create and edit a product: [[guide:product-management|Product Management — Create and Edit a Product]]
overview: **Document**: upload, organise, share and set reminders for the product's files.
**Shipping Detail**: sizes, weights and barcodes for the selling unit and cartons.
**Compliance Data**: record test results, certificates and other compliance data.
**Quality Requirement**: list the product's quality requirements, use templates and send them to testing or document review.
**AI Risk Screening**: run AI compliance screenings for this product.
**CPSC eFiling**: submit eFiling for this product and see its eFiling log.
**Packaging Detail**: record each packaging component, its materials and suppliers.

body: Shows every file linked to the product. Use **New Folder** to organise files and **Upload** to add a file (see the Document Management guide for the upload pop-up). Filter by **Type**, **Source** or **Checked**, switch between **All** and **Archived**, and search with **Search Files**. **Sort** and **Reset** sit with those filters.

body.caption: Document tab with one test report and the filter controls.
body.alt: Document tab of Kids Stainless Steel Water Bottle 500 ml with one test report PDF, New Folder, Upload and the Type, Source, Checked and Sort filters.

body: Tick one or more files to open the toolbar:

table: Add compliance data (test, certificate or other) from this file.
Set issue, expiry and review dates and an email reminder.
Move the file to the Archived tab.
Create a share link with an expiry period. Copy it or send it by email.
Change the file name or document type.
Move the file to a folder.

body.caption: Toolbar after selecting a file.
body.alt: Selection toolbar with Set Data, Set Dates & Reminder, Archive, Download, Share and Rename.

body.caption: Share Via Link — choose how long the link stays valid, then Copy or By Email.

body: Shows the length, width, height, gross and net weight, quantity and barcode for the **Selling Unit**, **Inner Carton** and **Outer Carton**. To change them, click **⋮** next to the product name → **Edit product** and update **Shipping Information**.

body.caption: Shipping Detail tab — empty values (0.00 / N/A).
body.alt: Shipping Detail tab with 0.00 measurements and N/A barcodes for Selling Unit, Inner Carton and Outer Carton.

body: Three sections: **Test Data**, **Certificate Data** and **Other**. Click **Add Data** (or **Add** once a section has records).

body.caption: Compliance Data tab before any data is added.
body.alt: Compliance Data tab with Test Data, Certificate Data and Other each empty and an Add Data button.

body: **Test Data** records one test result:

list: **Result** (required): Passed, Failed or Report As Is.
**Export Market** (required). For US eFiling, choose **United States (CPSC eFiling submission)**.
**Legislation, Test Item & Citation** (required): type a keyword such as “lead” and pick the test item from the list.
**Report ID**, **Issue Party** (required), **Expiry Date** and **Test Date / Report Date**.
Link the report under **Existing Product Document** (a file already on the product) or **New Document** (upload a new file).

body.caption: Search legislation and test items by keyword.
body.alt: Test Data form with Export Market United States and the keyword lead showing a list of matching legislation and test items.

body.caption: A completed Test Data record with the report attached.
body.alt: Test Data form filled in: Passed, United States, CPSIA lead in coating and substrate, report HK2611-04587, issue party ICW, test date 2026-11-12 and the report PDF under New Document.

body: Click **Confirm**. QMAS shows “Data Created” and the record appears in the Test Data table with its export market, legislation, test item, citation, report ID and issue party.

body.caption: Saved test data.
body.alt: Compliance Data tab with one Test Data record: United States, CPSIA, lead in coating and substrate, CPSIA & 16 CFR 1303, HK2611-04587, ICW.

body: **Certificate Data** works the same way. Fill in the certificate **Type**, **Issue Party**, **Score / Overall Rating**, **Expiry Date** and **Certificate Date**, then link the certificate file.

body.caption: Certificate Data form.
body.alt: Certificate Data form with Type, Issue Party, score and date fields.

body: Quality Requirement lists what the product must meet, for example a chemical test or a physical test. Each requirement has a **Type** (the group) and a **Name**. You can attach compliance data to a requirement as proof, mark it as completed, and send the requirements to Product Testing or Document Review.

body.caption: Quality Requirement tab before any requirement is added: Add Requirement, Test Plan and the ⋯ menu.
body.alt: Empty Quality Requirement tab with the Add Requirement button, Test Plan and the more menu.

body: **4a. Add a requirement yourself**

list: Click **Add Requirement** (or **Add** at the top right once the list has items).
**Type**: pick an existing type, or type a new one and choose **+ Create “…”**. Example: *Chemical Testing*.
**Name**: pick a name from the list for that type, or type a new one and choose **+ Create “…”**. Example: *Lead in Surface Coating (16 CFR 1303)*. Picking a different Type clears the Name.
Tick **Mandatory** if the requirement must be met, then click **Confirm**. QMAS shows “Requirement Created”.

body.caption: Add Requirement with Type, Name and Mandatory filled in.
body.alt: Add Requirement pop-up with Type Chemical Testing, Name Lead in Surface Coating (16 CFR 1303) and Mandatory ticked.

body: Requirements are grouped by Type. The number next to the Type is how many requirements it has, and a red * marks a mandatory requirement.

body.caption: Requirements grouped by Type: Chemical Testing and Physical Testing.
body.alt: Quality Requirement list with a Chemical Testing group and a Physical Testing group, one mandatory requirement each.

body: **4b. Reuse requirements with templates**
Click **⋯** next to the title → **Templates**:

table: Search for a saved template, use **View** to preview it, then click **Apply**. All its requirements are added to this product.
Save this product's requirements as a template. Type a new name and choose **+ Create “…”**, then click **Confirm**. QMAS shows “Template saved”.
See and manage your saved templates.

body.caption: ⋯ → Templates: Apply Template, Save As Template and Manage Templates.
body.alt: The more menu open on Templates, showing Apply Template, Save As Template and Manage Templates.

body.caption: Save As Template — name the template, then click Confirm.
body.alt: Save As Template pop-up with the name US Children's Drinkware.

body.caption: Apply Template — search, View or Apply a saved template.
body.alt: Apply Template pop-up showing the template US Children's Drinkware with View and Apply buttons.

body: After you click **Apply**, QMAS shows “<template name> applied” and the template's requirements appear in the list.
**4c. Attach proof and complete a requirement**

list: Click **+** on a requirement to open **Attach Compliance Data**. Choose the **Test Data**, **Certificate Data** or **Other** tab, tick the records and click **Confirm**. QMAS shows “Data Added”. If a record you just added is missing, click **Reload Data**. To add new data, go to the Compliance Data tab first.
The attached data appears under the requirement. Click **⌄** to expand or collapse it, and the bin icon to detach it.
Click **⋯** on a requirement for **Edit**, **Duplicate**, **Upload Document**, **Mark As Completed** and **Remove**.
**Mark As Completed** shows “Requirement Completed” and turns the requirement’s tick green.

body.caption: Attach Compliance Data — tick the test record, then click Confirm.
body.alt: Attach Compliance Data pop-up on the Test Data tab with one United States lead-in-coating record ticked, report HK2611-04587, result Passed.

body.caption: The attached test data under the requirement.
body.alt: Requirement Lead in Surface Coating with the attached CPSIA and 16 CFR 1303 lead in coating test data shown below it.

body.caption: ⋯ menu on one requirement.
body.alt: Requirement menu with Edit, Duplicate, Upload Document, Mark As Completed and Remove.

body.caption: Requirement marked as completed — the ticks turn green.
body.alt: Chemical Testing group and its requirement with green ticks after Mark As Completed.

body: **4d. Send requirements to a job**

list: **⋯ → Import To Product Testing**: click **Select** on each requirement (or **Select All**), then click **Confirm to Create Job**. Product Testing → Request Quotations opens with this product added, and the requirements appear under **Quality Requirement** in step 2.
**⋯ → Import to Document Review** → **Create Job** or **Create Job for supplier**: opens the matching Document Review form for this product.
**⋯ → Export As Document**: exports the requirement list as a document.

body.caption: Import To Product Testing — select requirements, then Confirm to Create Job.
body.alt: Quality Requirement selection pop-up with both requirements selected and the Confirm to Create Job button.

body.caption: The requirements carried into Product Testing step 2.
body.alt: Request Quotations step 2 with both requirements listed under Quality Requirement.

body.caption: Import to Document Review → Create Job or Create Job for supplier.
body.alt: The more menu open on Import to Document Review, showing Create Job and Create Job for supplier.

body: **4e. Test Plan (AI)**

Click **Test Plan** to let AI suggest a test plan. Fill in the **Product Description** (more detail gives better results), **Import Country** and **Product Intended Used By**, upload up to 6 product images, then click **Generate Test Plan**.

body.caption: Test Plan pop-up.
body.alt: Test Plan pop-up with Product Description, Import Country, Product Intended Used By, product image upload and Generate Test Plan.

body: Lists the AI screenings for this product. Click **Add** to start one. The pop-up and results are explained in the [[guide:ai-insight|AI Insight]] guide.

body.caption: AI Risk Screening tab.
body.alt: AI Risk Screening tab with Output Mode, Status and Sort filters and an Add button.

body: Shows the **eFiling Log** for this product. Click **Submit eFiling** to create an eFiling. Before you can sync with CPSC, add your API Key and Secret Key in **Company Profile** (link in the grey note). The full flow is in the [[guide:efiling|eFiling]] guide.

body.caption: CPSC eFiling tab.
body.alt: CPSC eFiling tab with the eFiling Log, Submit eFiling and the Company Profile note.

body: Lists the packaging components of the product. Click **Create Packaging Component** and fill in:

list: **Basic Information**: name and description (required), identification no., function, legal role, weight, material type and name, status (Active, Inactive or Draft), and packaging images.
**Dimension**, **Additional Information**, **Supplier Linkage** and **Technical Documentation** (expand each section).

body: Click **Confirm**. Use the **Status** filter to show active, inactive or draft components.

body.alt: Packaging Details tab with the Status filter, Create Packaging Component and an empty component list.

body.caption: Create Packaging Component.
body.alt: Create Packaging Component pop-up with Basic Information filled in and the Dimension, Additional Information, Supplier Linkage and Technical Documentation sections.

body: On the Product Management list, click **Import Product**. Download the ICW Product template (**download here**), fill it in, upload the Excel file (one file at a time), then click **Next**. Only the ICW template can be used.

body.caption: Import Product.
body.alt: Import Product pop-up with the ICW template download link and the Excel upload area.

tips: **Hide product details** at the top right hides the product card on the left.
Link test reports to Test Data. eFiling can reuse this data when you quick-select test data.
Use requirement **Templates** so similar products get the same requirements.
faq: How do I add a test result to a product?
Open the product → Compliance Data → Test Data → Add Data. Fill in Result, Export Market, Legislation/Test Item, Issue Party, link the report, then Confirm.
How do I share a product document?
Open the product → Document, tick the file, click Share, choose the link expiry, then Copy or By Email.
How do I add quality requirements to a product?
Open the product → Quality Requirement → Add Requirement, or ⋯ → Templates to apply a saved template.
Where do I record packaging information?
Open the product → Packaging Detail → Create Packaging Component.
How do I import many products?
On Product Management, click Import Product, download the ICW template, fill it in and upload it.
How do I reuse quality requirements for many products?
Open a product → Quality Requirement → ⋯ → Templates → Save As Template. On other products use ⋯ → Templates → Apply Template.
How do I prove a requirement is met?
On the requirement click +, attach the test or certificate data, then ⋯ → Mark As Completed.
